prompt: Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: a young woman leaning against a wall next to a subway train platform with her hair blowing in the wind. Composition: vertical waist-to-upper-thigh portrait on a subway platform, subject placed on the right third against the tiled wall, train and platform receding in soft blur along the left side, tight headroom, lower body cropped before the knees, camera at about eye level with a mild 35-50mm conversation-distance feel. Wardrobe: Victoria Beckham pale-blue jersey dress, low pointed pumps. Setting: underground subway platform beside a glossy tiled wall, train on the opposite left edge, long fluorescent ceiling lights stretching into the distance, yellow platform strip and small warm orange station lights blurred in the background. Lighting: greenish fluorescent overhead and wall-reflected light, uneven mixed temperature with cool teal-green dominance and small warm orange bokeh in the distance; soft low-light shadows, no studio fill. Finish: low-light subway photo finish with a green fluorescent cast, muted teal shadows, warm orange bokeh highlights, soft highlight roll-off on the wall tiles, moderate contrast with slightly crushed dark areas, visible fine grain and soft sensor noise in the shadows; skin keeps visible pores, faint under-eye texture, and a slight natural shine instead of plastic smoothing.
